offerings.name: Web Search API
offerings.pricing: Hobby: $16/month billed annually, for 5,000 credits per month (2,500 searches or 5,000 pages scraped). Search costs 2 credits per 10 results.
offerings.price_basis: Hobby 年付（2,500 次搜索/月，按每次最多10条结果）
offerings.free_quota: 1,000 credits every month（500 searches），no credit card required.
offerings.output_type: 结构化网页、新闻和图片搜索结果，含标题、描述与URL；可选抓取全文Markdown、HTML、链接或截图
offerings.note: 搜索按每10条结果2 credits计费并向上取整；启用内容抓取时另收逐页抓取费用。
